headline: Square vs Stripe vs Shopify Payments
description: Compare Square, Stripe, and Shopify Payments US online and in-person rates—with $100 examples, plan tiers, and guidance on when each commerce stack wins.

itemListElement.name: Square vs Stripe vs Shopify Payments

mainEntity.name: Is Shopify Payments cheaper than Stripe?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Basic, online list rates often match Stripe at 2.9% + $0.30. Shopify and Advanced plans list lower online card rates (2.7% / 2.5% + $0.30) but higher subscriptions. Compare total cost at your volume.

mainEntity.name: Does Square beat Stripe for cafés?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often on fee mix when most volume is in-person at 2.6% + $0.10 versus online-shaped 2.9% + $0.30. Hardware, software, and payout features still matter—run both calculators on your ticket size.

mainEntity.name: What is the fee on a $100 online charge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stripe and Square online: $3.20 (net $96.80). Shopify Basic: same shape. Shopify plan: $3.00. Advanced: $2.80. Confirm on official pricing and our calculators.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Stripe inside Shopify?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shopify’s ecosystem and third-party gateways have specific rules and possible fees beyond Shopify Payments. Check Shopify’s current gateway documentation; native Shopify Payments rates above assume you use Shopify Payments.

mainEntity.name: Where should I compare side by side?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use /tools/compare-payment-fees/ with your average order value, and read Stripe vs PayPal fees if wallets are in scope.
